दिया गया है:

\n\n

एक वृत्त की जीवा की लंबाई 24 सेमी है, और केंद्र तथा जीवा के बीच की लंबवत दूरी 5 सेमी है।

\n\n

प्रयुक्त अवधारणा:

\n\n

केंद्र से लंबवत दूरी का उपयोग करके जीवा की लंबाई = 2 × √(R2 - d2)

\n\n

(जहाँ r = वृत्त की त्रिज्या, d = केंद्र और जीवा के बीच की दूरी)

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

माना वृत्त की त्रिज्या R है।

\n\n

\n\n

यहाँ,

\n\n

AB = 24 सेमी लंबी जीवा

\n\n

OD = केंद्र और जीवा के बीच की लंबवत दूरी

\n\n

OB = त्रिज्या

\n\n

अवधारणा के अनुसार,

\n\n

24 = 2 × √(R2 - d2)√√√√

\n\n

⇒ 12 = √(R2 - d2)√√√√

\n\n

⇒ 144 = R2 - 52

\n\n

⇒ R2 = 169

⇒ R = 13

\n\n

∴ वृत्त की त्रिज्या 13 सेमी है।

11x + 1 = 0 எனில், x 8 - 14159x 4 + 11 இன் மதிப்பு என்ன?", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "9"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "10"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "12"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "11"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

Given:

\n\n

x2 - 11x + 1 = 0

\n\n

Concept used:

\n\n

If x + 1/x = p then x2 + 1/x2 = p2 - 2

\n\n

Calculation:

\n\n

On dividing x2 - 11x + 1 by x we get,

\n\n

⇒ x - 11 + 1/x = 0

\n\n

⇒ x + 1/x = 11

\n\n

⇒ x2 + 1/x2 = (11)2 - 2

\n\n

⇒ x2 + 1/x2 = 121 - 2

\n\n

x2 + 1/x2 = 119

\n\n

Squaring both sides

\n\n

⇒ x4 + 1/x4  = 14161 - 2 = 14159

\n\n

x8 - 14159x4 + 11

\n\n

⇒ x4(x4 - 14159) + 11

\n\n

⇒ x4(x4 - x4 - 1/x4) + 11

\n\n

⇒ x4(- 1/x4) + 11

\n\n

⇒ -1 + 11 = 10

\n\n

The answer is 10.

Given:

\n\n

A company offers four types of successive discounts:

\n\n

I.  25% and 15%

\n\n

II. 30% and 10%

\n\n

III. 35% and 5% 

\n\n

IV. Both 20% each 

\n\n

Formula used:

\n\n

Overall discount formula = (a + b - ab/100×�100×�100 )%

\n\n

दिया गया है:

\n\n

एक कंपनी चार प्रकार की क्रमिक छूट प्रदान करती है।

\n\n

I.  25% और 15%

\n\n

II. 30% और 10%

\n\n

III. 35% और 5% 

\n\n

IV. प्रत्येक 20% की

\n\n

प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

\n\n

संपूर्ण छूट सूत्र = (a + b - ab/100×�100×�100 )%

\n\n

गणना:

\n\n

I. 25% और 15% की छूट

\n\n

संपूर्ण छूट = (25 + 15 - (25 × 15)/100×15100×15100 )% = 36.25%

\n\n

II. 30% और 10% की छूट

\n\n

संपूर्ण छूट = (30 + 10 - (30 × 10)/100)% = 37%

\n\n

III. 35% और 5% की छूट

\n\n

संपूर्ण छूट = (35 + 5 - (35 × 5)/100×15100×15100 )% = 38.25%

\n\n

IV. 20% औत्र 20% की छूट

\n\n

संपूर्ण छूट = (20 + 20 - (20 × 20)/100×15100×15100 )% = 36%

\n\n

उपरोक्त परिणाम की तुलना करने पर, यह अनुमान लगाया जा सकता है कि,

\n\n

∴ तीसरी छूट ग्राहकों के लिए सबसे अच्छी है।

\n\n13a:T5aed,\n

ఇచ్చిన ఇచ్చిన దత్తాంశం:  

\n\n

ఒక కంపెనీ వరుసగా నాలుగు రకాల తగ్గింపులను అందిస్తుంది:

\n\n

I. 25% మరియు 15%

\n\n

II. 30% మరియు 10%

\n\n

III. 35% మరియు 5%

\n\n

IV. రెండూ ఒక్కొక్కటి 20%

\n\n

ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం: 

\n\n

మొత్తం తగ్గింపు సూత్రం = (a + b - ab/100 × 100 × 100 )%

\n\n

సాధన:            

\n\n

\n\n

I. 25% మరియు 15% కోసం ఆఫర్

\n\n

మొత్తం తగ్గింపు = (25 + 15 - ( 25 × 15)/100 × 15 100 × 15 100 )% = 36.25%

\n\n

II. 30% మరియు 10% కోసం ఆఫర్

\n\n

మొత్తం తగ్గింపు = (30 + 10 - ( 30 × 10)/100) % = 37%

\n\n

III. 35% మరియు 5% కోసం ఆఫర్

\n\n

మొత్తం తగ్గింపు = (35 + 5 - ( 35 × 5)/100 × 15 100 × 15 100 )% = 38.25%

\n\n

IV. 20% మరియు 20% కోసం ఆఫర్

\n\n

మొత్తం తగ్గింపు = (20 + 20 - ( 20 × 20)/100 × 15 100 × 15 100 )% = 36%

\n\n

పై ఫలితాన్ని పోల్చి చూస్తే, దీనిని ఊహించవచ్చు,

\n\n

∴ మూడవ ఆఫర్ వినియోగదారులకు ఉత్తమమైనది.

\n\n

ஒட்டுமொத்த தள்ளுபடி = (35 + 5 - ( 35 × 5)/100 × 15 100 × 15 100 )% = 38.25%

\n\n

IV. 20% மற்றும் 20%க்கான சலுகை

\n\n

ஒட்டுமொத்த தள்ளுபடி = (20 + 20 - ( 20 × 20)/100 × 15 100 × 15 100 )% = 36%

    \n\n42:Ta0c,\n

    Direction: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.

    \n\n

    A. have seen a major blow

    \n\n

    B. the last two years

    \n\n

    C. people, and lower-income countries

    \n\n

    D. to the world’s economy and

    \n\n

    E. were hit particularly hard

    \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "BCADE"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "EBCAD"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "BADCE"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "ADBEC"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

    The correct answer is "BADCE". 

    \n\n

    Key Points

    \n\n
      \n\t
    • B. the last two years -\n\t
        \n\t\t
      • This is establishing a timeframe within which something happened.
        • \n\t\t
      • This makes sense to start the sentence, so we know when the events occurred.
        • \n\t
      \n\t
      • \n\t
    • A. have seen a major blow -\n\t
        \n\t\t
      • This is stating the experience of whoever or whatever the sentence is about.
        • \n\t\t
      • "Have seen a major blow" means that they have been hit hard or badly affected by something.
        • \n\t\t
      • As it is phrased as an effect, it should follow a subject.
        • \n\t
      \n\t
      • \n\t
    • D. to the world’s economy and -\n\t
        \n\t\t
      • It seems to refer to the subjects that were negatively affected.
        • \n\t\t
      • This clause should precede A to establish what was affected.
        • \n\t
      \n\t
      • \n\t
    • C. people and lower-income countries -\n\t
        \n\t\t
      • This clause specifies other entities that have been affected.
        • \n\t\t
      • Ideally, it should come after the things that were affected were mentioned.
        • \n\t\t
      • Since D already mentions the world's economy, this clause completes the subjects which have seen the major blow.
        • \n\t
      \n\t
      • \n\t
    • E. were hit particularly hard -\n\t
        \n\t\t
      • This finishes the sentence by specifically focusing on how badly "people and lower-income countries" were affected.
        • \n\t
      \n\t
      • \n\t
    • Therefore, the sentence correctly structured appears as follows:\n\t
        \n\t\t
      • The last two years have seen a major blow to the world’s economy and people, and lower-income countries were hit particularly hard. 
        • \n\t
      \n\t
      • \n
    \n\n

    So, the correct sequence is "Option 3".

      The correct answer is "This phone is inferior to that one."
      \n
      \n Key Points

      \n\n
        \n\t
      • "Inferior" is a comparative adjective, so it needs to be followed by "to" when comparing two things.
        • \n\t
      • "Than" is used to make comparisons with adjectives that are not comparative, such as "better" or "worse."
        • \n\t
      • "More inferior" is redundant because "inferior" already implies a lower quality.
        • \n\t
      • "Of" is not the correct preposition to use when making comparisons.
        • \n\t
      • We always use comparative adjectives (like inferior) with "than" or "to" to show comparison.\n\t
          \n\t\t
        • Example: The performance of the new model is inferior to that of its predecessor in terms of speed and efficiency.
          • \n\t
        \n\t
        • \n\t
      • The correct answer is Option 4.
        • \n
